+from __future__ import annotations

+

+    bowls = s.objects()
+    b1 = np.asarray(bowls["bowl_1"]["position"], dtype=float)
+    b2 = np.asarray(bowls["bowl_2"]["position"], dtype=float)
+    top = float(bowls["table"]["bounds"][1][2])
+    q = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+    print("initial", json.dumps(bowls), "ee", s.ee_pose()[0].round(4).tolist(), flush=True)
+
+    # The bowls flare at the rim, so pinch the narrow lower wall with the
+    # vertical fingers, then carry the right bowl over the left one.
+    picked = False
+    for grasp_z in (top + 0.009, top + 0.015, top + 0.022):
+        s.reset()
+        p = s.primitives()
+        p["open_gripper"](4)
+        s.record_start()
+        print("grasp attempt z", grasp_z, flush=True)
+        p["move_ee"]([b1[0], b1[1], 0.17], q, speed=0.16, settle=2)
+        p["move_ee"]([b1[0], b1[1], grasp_z], q, speed=0.11, settle=2)
+        p["close_gripper"](22)
+        p["hold"](5)
+        print("closed", "angle", s.gripper_angle(), "obj", s.object_pose("bowl_1")[0].round(4).tolist(), flush=True)
+        p["move_ee"]([b1[0], b1[1], 0.17], q, speed=0.12)
+        after_lift = s.object_pose("bowl_1")[0]

+        picked = after_lift[2] > b1[2] + 0.025
+        if picked:

+        failed = s.record_stop()
+        print("failed_pick_actions", len(failed), flush=True)
+
+    if not picked:

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session


OUT = "/app/output"
TASK = "bowl_stacking_right_on_left"
INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"


def move(p, name, xyz, quat, **kw):
    try:
        err = p["move_ee"](xyz, quat, **kw)
        print(name, "reached", np.round(xyz, 4), "err", err, flush=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(name, "stopped", repr(exc), flush=True)


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    s = Session(TASK, instance=INSTANCE)
    p = s.primitives()
    objs = s.objects()
    b1 = np.asarray(objs["bowl_1"]["position"], float)
    b2 = np.asarray(objs["bowl_2"]["position"], float)
    zt = float(objs["table"]["bounds"][1][2])
    qy = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
    qx = p["top_down_quat"](np.pi / 2)
    print("initial", json.dumps(objs), flush=True)
    p["open_gripper"](5)
    s.record_start()

    # Slide bowl_1 toward bowl_2 along the open side of the rim.
    y0 = float(b1[1] - 0.14)
    y1 = float(b1[1] + 0.10)
    move(p, "y pre", [b1[0], y0, 0.17], qy, speed=0.14)
    move(p, "y low", [b1[0], y0, zt + 0.008], qy, speed=0.08)
    move(p, "y sweep", [b1[0], y1, zt + 0.008], qy, speed=0.07, max_dq=0.04)
    p["hold"](20)
    print("after y sweep", s.object_pose("bowl_1")[0].round(4), s.object_pose("bowl_2")[0].round(4), s.status(), flush=True)

    # Pull from the far x rim all the way across the left bowl's opening.
    if not s.episode_done:
        cur = np.asarray(s.object_pose("bowl_1")[0])
        left = np.asarray(s.object_pose("bowl_2")[0])
        x0, y = float(cur[0] + 0.08), float(cur[1])
        move(p, "x pre", [x0, y, 0.17], qx, speed=0.12)
        move(p, "x low", [x0, y, zt + 0.027], qx, speed=0.08)
        p["close_gripper"](25)
        cur = np.asarray(s.object_pose("bowl_1")[0])
        left = np.asarray(s.object_pose("bowl_2")[0])
        print("x grip", s.gripper_angle(), cur.round(4), flush=True)
        # The tool tracks the near rim of bowl_1 by roughly 8.5 cm; stop just
        # outside bowl_2's rim so bowl_1's centroid lands over its cavity.
        move(p, "x pull", [float(left[0] + 0.085), float(left[1]), zt + 0.04], qx,
             speed=0.05, max_dq=0.035, max_steps=240)
        p["open_gripper"](12)
        p["hold"](45)

    final = s.status()
    print("final", final, "bowl1", s.object_pose("bowl_1")[0].round(4), "bowl2", s.object_pose("bowl_2")[0].round(4), flush=True)
    actions = s.record_stop()
    if final["success"]:
        s.save_trajectory(actions, f"{OUT}/trajectory.npz", meta={"method": "rim slide and pull", "n_actions": len(actions)})
        print("SAVED", actions.shape, flush=True)
    else:
        np.savez(f"{OUT}/candidate.npz", actions=actions)
        print("FAILED", actions.shape, flush=True)
    s.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
